title: Solarpunk rebellion plot in my dreams?
content: Has anyone heard of the concept of solarpunk? My dreams all take place in this alternate reality. It’s been this setting for quite a while, but recently the plot has turned into a solarpunk rebellion. So basically my mall is a blimp, but its like a cruise ship in the sky that’s probably the size of the city. The earth is known to be pretty much uninhabitable/ only unfortunate people who maybe couldn’t afford to live the blimp cruise ship life rough it out on the ground. Is basically post apocalyptic. But recently the blimp has began to malfunction/deteriorate and the workers are hiding things. There’s a rebellion coming because the blimp people are starting to realize that its all been a facade to placate the well off folks into ignoring the crisis of earth’s environmental destruction.
